children: The American Petroleum Institute reportedly shows a surprise draw of 11.1M barrels of oil in U.S. commercial stockpiles for the week ending October 9, after inventories fell by more than 2M barrels in the previous week.

Gasoline inventories reportedly show a build of 1.1M barrels for the week, distillate inventories reportedly show a draw of 1.5M barrels, and Cushing inventories reportedly show a build of 1.82M barrels.
The Energy Information Administration is scheduled to release its weekly U.S. petroleum supply report on Thursday, with the average of analysts surveyed by

forecasting domestic commercial crude stocks would rise by 100K barrels, while gasoline inventories were expected to fall by 900K barrels and distillate inventories were forecast to fall by 1.5M barrels.
